usable_improvement: Original editable unitless Ari bomber interior/lining/facing artist-intent sheet, paired with retained exterior in a readable local review. Make the unseen inner body/sleeve/facing/pocket/rib attachment relationships inspectable without constructing a garment.
bounded_question: Can a full declared inside layout give each retained exterior feature and every proposed lining/facing/pocket boundary an explicit visible parent, or is a partial/unlined alternative the more coherent artist choice?
decision: A complete declared lining/facing visual-intent design if actual retained sources and up to two primary reference examples support it; B explicitly scoped partial/unlined study or withhold authorship if unresolved. Neither chooses physical topology, sewing, dimensions, body occupancy or a constructor.

research_bounds.local_sources: Read retained original brief/drawing/json and actual images before design. No fixed-loft/body/field construction or collector correction.
research_bounds.online: Up to two Firecrawl searches, six results each, only primary manufacturer/pattern-maker/museum sources; read at most two selected pages, no bulk crawl or retries. Relevant official jacket lining/material contrast and pattern-maker facing/back/sleeve interface images. Distinguish observed details from original design choices.
research_bounds.image_examples: Actually inspect retained originals and selected primary image examples where accessible, not URLs alone. No copying reference artwork or remote media download to bypass display restrictions. Root serializes any browser captures.
research_bounds.design: One original SVG and declarative JSON component/parent/join intent, no executable geometry. All intended components/endpoints named, left/right/view conventions explicit; no physical/sewing/fit/completeness beyond the declared artist views. Preserve Ari exterior proportions/features/palette unless a deliberate documented artist alternative.
research_bounds.render: Root-only local SVG/HTML rendered packet, at most two candidate captures including one correction, plus at most two primary reference views. No 3D/Blender/WebGPU/avatar worker. Actual pixels qualify composition/legibility/coherence only.
research_bounds.review: Independent worth before investigation, source review before capture, actual image critic and root independent inspection. Each actionable issue source/image witness+explanation+two alternatives/tradeoffs. No unsupported quality promotion.
research_bounds.delivery: If artist scope passes, preserve editable source and actual captured image with concise artist handoff; optionally add only this specific artist deliverable to existing board/checklist after review. All broad outstanding goals remain.

alternatives.choice: A continuous declared lining with explicit facing/rib/pocket interface intent
alternatives.tradeoff: Provides inspectable complete-inside artist direction, but all physical panel/sewing/3D/fit/motion properties remain open.
Fewer unresolved inside relationships but a distinct aesthetic choice; cannot silently replace the retained jacket intent.

preserve: Original Ari references/drawings/geometry, all accepted/default/frozen/unused assets and unrelated worktrees. Computational collector/source routes closed this window. AAA character/expression/wardrobe/representation/physical/morph/pose/motion/export/performance/VTuber/Mii retained. Existing allowance only/no purchases/install/push/publish/models/subscription/resetcredits. Latest human steering wins.
